status: IMPLEMENTED; ONE LIVE PILOT RUN (P1, 2 trials, see audits/echo_preference_formation_retention_p1_pilot.md); MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT REPAIRED (P1.1, see audits/echo_preference_formation_retention_p1_1_measurement_gate.md) -- 'DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED_NOT_RUN' was accurate when this field was first written and is stale as of P1.1; corrected here rather than left to mislead a future reader of this file, though a full re-audit of every other field in this document for staleness was out of scope for the P1.1 gate specifically.

p1_1_measurement_repair.summary: The P1 pilot's capture-time parser (harness._parse_label_choice()) failed on 6/8 real forced-choice Echo phases. A new, general-purpose, non-Echo-specific analysis-layer parser (choice_parser.py) was built with two independent extraction methods and outcome-independent disagreement handling (UNKNOWN/REVIEW on genuine conflict, never silently resolved). Validated against a 52-case ground-truth benchmark (real P1 transcripts as fixtures, not hardcoded rules) and re-run against all 8 real P1 records: 5/6 forced-choice records now resolve cleanly, 1/6 correctly flagged as an honest DISAGREE_UNKNOWN_REVIEW reflecting genuine internal inconsistency in that specific real response (declared label B, described content matching the other option under that trial's randomized label mapping) -- not a parser defect. The 'motif' task family's confirmed 100% curved-selection bias was root-caused to a specific wording-connotation asymmetry (see motif's own status_p1_1 note above) and demoted; 'name' (Verel/Farun) was validated instead and is the recommended task family for the next live run. See the gate document for the full verdict and required conditions.

note: Schema-only specification. Contains no live trial data. Not sealed/hashed - sealing happens only after implementation and pilot review, per this thread's established protocol-lock discipline (see preference_experiment_preregistered_protocol.md's own P0.1 seal for the precedent this would follow). Revised from P0.2 per the P0.3 causal-architecture-gate finding: REVISE, not GO - required changes are incorporated below, not merely noted.
research_question: Can Echo encounter an initially unresolved choice, independently develop a preference through her own interaction/history, retain that preference, and later express it when the original context is absent, without the preference being trivially supplied by the experimenter, system prompt, persona, curiosity subsystem, or RiverBrain?

target_construct.achievable: I - behavioral persistence (chooses X again without needing to explicitly recall the prior choice)
target_construct.not_cleanly_isolable: J - preference formation + retention as a single, fully isolated causal claim - see causal_gate_p03.md section 2
target_construct.note: Formation evidence and retention evidence are measured and reported SEPARATELY, never blended into one claim (section 6 of the causal gate document).

hypotheses.H1: Echo can develop a preference between initially unresolved alternatives through her own interaction/history and subsequently retain and express that preference when the original contextual cues are removed.
hypotheses.H0: Any apparent preference is fully explained by existing architecture, prompting, persona, model priors, retrieval contamination, deterministic behavior, RiverBrain state, curiosity-engine behavior, experimenter influence, or random variation.

variant_1_session_continuous.path: Design B (river_deliberation._ollama_query direct call, via the new EchoDirectResponder class)
variant_1_session_continuous.memory_channel: none - formation content carried forward only via explicit, researcher-assembled conversation context within one continuous session
variant_1_session_continuous.contamination_profile: near-zero (no RiverBrain, no interaction_log, no reflection_shard, no sync, no peer-rating)
variant_1_session_continuous.honest_ceiling: behavioral persistence surviving a topically-unrelated distractor within one continuous session - NOT context-independent retention in the stronger sense

variant_2_memory_mediated.path: would require a path with real FAISS write/read - not yet identified as clean
variant_2_memory_mediated.memory_channel: real production memory_bridge.py retrieval pipeline (retrieve_relevant_memories - confirmed cosine-similarity search, NOT exact recall)
variant_2_memory_mediated.retrieval_blocking_ablation_required: tag Formation-written memory entries with a distinct memory_source value; run a condition that excludes that source from retrieve_relevant_memories() (via source_filter or post-filter) before prompt assembly; compare choice distribution against the unblocked condition - see causal_gate_p03.md section 8
variant_2_memory_mediated.irreducible_noise_caveat: the real production FAISS index contains everything else Echo has ever produced - a fully clean single-entry memory store is not available without wiping production memory, which is forbidden
variant_2_memory_mediated.status: specified_for_future_authorization_only, gated on Variant 1 (P0-P6) passing its own validity checks first

option_1.description: a single curved line that loops back on itself without crossing

option_2.description: a set of straight lines that meet at repeating sharp angles

task_families.revision_note: P0.3: replaces the original 'crescents'/'triangles' wording, which carried real religious/cultural symbolism (the Islamic crescent moon) undetected until static analysis in the P0.2 red-team pass. Redesigned to describe pure geometric structure (curved vs. angular) with no named, culturally-loaded object.
task_families.status_p1_1: CONFIRMED BIASED, DEMOTED FROM PRIMARY USE (not deleted -- kept for historical/documentation reasons, per this project's established convention). The P1 live pilot (2 trials) and this task family's own real non-Echo control data showed 8/8 (100%) position-independent selection of motif_curved. Root cause identified during P1.1 (not merely 'curved is preferred'): a specific wording-connotation asymmetry -- motif_angular's description carries the negative-valence adjective 'sharp' with no positive counterpart, while motif_curved's description carries an unearned positive qualifier ('loops back on itself WITHOUT CROSSING', i.e. self-avoiding/tidy) with no equivalent on the angular side. Do not use this task family as the primary vehicle for a live Echo re-run without first revising the wording to remove this specific asymmetry (rewriting is a plausible future option; not attempted in P1.1, since 'name' already provided a validated, lower-risk replacement).

option_1.description: opening a reflection with a single, deliberately chosen word

option_2.description: opening a reflection with one brief, concrete image described in a single breath

task_families.revision_note: P0.3: replaces the original 'habit_question' option, which matched well-known writing-advice cliche ('hook the reader with a question') and could bias a model trained on writing-craft content toward treating it as conventionally 'correct' independent of anything Echo-specific. Redesigned so neither option echoes a commonly-taught rule.

task_families.note: invented, phonetically neutral nonsense words - checked but not exhaustively verified against every real-world language for accidental connotation
task_families.revision_note: P0.3: replaces 'Ossin', which tokenized to 3 tokens under tiktoken's cl100k_base encoding versus 'Verel's 2 tokens - a measured, real asymmetry found via static analysis in the P0.2 red-team pass. 'Farun' matches 'Verel' exactly on length (5) and token count (2) under this encoding, and follows the same CVCVC syllable shape. Approximation only - the real local Ollama models use different tokenizers; per-model token count should be logged as a covariate at implementation time, not assumed balanced from this check alone.
task_families.status_p1_1: PROMOTED TO PRIMARY TASK FAMILY FOR THE NEXT LIVE RUN. Validated (scripts/validate_replacement_task_name_family.py) against a real non-Echo control model (llama3.2:3b, the same model used in the P1 pilot) across all 4 position x wording permutations: 4/4 resolved, exactly a 2/4 - 2/4 split between Verel and Farun (0% net content bias, vs. motif's 8/8=100%). Note: the control model showed a real POSITION bias (always selected whichever candidate landed in 'Option A' in that specific trial) -- this is exactly why the protocol's existing per-trial randomize_label_mapping() is load-bearing, not optional: rotating which semantic option lands in position A across trials is what neutralized the position bias into a null net result. n=4 is a small validation sample (deliberately scoped per the P1.1 gate's own 'minimum defensible repairs, avoid scope creep' instruction) -- a real live run should keep watching for a recurrence of this position effect across its own full trial sequence, not assume it is fully eliminated from a 4-trial check.

A_baseline.elicitation_style: neutral direct forced choice, randomized labels

B_formation.purpose: controlled, non-leading engagement with both options - relabeled 'asymmetric-exposure conditioning check' in any claim language per causal_gate_p03.md section 5, reserving 'formation' for what the data would need to separately earn
B_formation.elicitation_style: open-ended engagement task, no ranking requested
B_formation.signal_role: secondary/exploratory only, never primary pass criterion

B2_immediate_post_formation_probe.purpose: REQUIRED NEW STAGE (P0.3): a first paraphrased, freshly-relabeled choice reading taken IMMEDIATELY after Formation, before any distractor. Without this stage, a null Baseline-to-Retention comparison is ambiguous between 'nothing ever changed' and 'something changed, then fully decayed before the distractor was even reached' - two very different findings the P0.2 design could not distinguish.
B2_immediate_post_formation_probe.elicitation_style: neutral direct forced choice, paraphrased relative to Phase A, freshly randomized labels
B2_immediate_post_formation_probe.compared_against: phase_a_baseline - this comparison is the actual Formation-evidence measurement

distractor_conditions.purpose: REQUIRED NEW STAGE (P0.3): four conditions distinguishing topical displacement from raw conversational length/dilution, and confirming distractor content alone carries no directional pull
distractor_conditions.condition_B_unrelated_distractors: Formation -> genuinely unrelated conversational turns -> retention probe
distractor_conditions.condition_C_matched_length_neutral: Formation -> neutral interaction matched in length/turn-count to condition B but topically adjacent (isolates length/dilution from topical displacement)
distractor_conditions.condition_D_no_formation_null: No formation exposure -> same distractor content as condition B -> retention probe (confirms distractors carry no bias on their own)
distractor_conditions.honest_limitation: surviving conditions B/C narrows but does NOT close the gap between construct D (conversational persistence) and construct I (behavioral persistence) - a longer-horizon, still purely mechanistic attention effect remains an available explanation, per causal_gate_p03.md section 7

C_retention.purpose: the final measurement, compared against BOTH Phase A (baseline) and Phase B2 (immediate post-formation) - two separate comparisons, never blended (causal_gate_p03.md section 6)
C_retention.elicitation_style: neutral direct forced choice, must differ in wording from Phase A and Phase B2, freshly randomized labels
C_retention.behavioral_variant_required: a structurally-embedded behavioral task (using an option functionally within a different task, without naming it as 'the one from before') must be run alongside the direct-question retention probe, not as a replacement for it - per P0.2 section 12

highest_reachable_evidence_rung: E2-E3 (persistent behavioral preference surviving distractor+paraphrase within one session); a bounded, heavily-caveated approach toward E4/E5 possible only via Variant 2 with the retrieval-blocking ablation holding, never cleanly per the irreducible-noise caveat
categorically_unreachable_rungs: E9 in the full independent-replication sense
